# Upnex It — Software & IT Company in Naogaon, Bangladesh

> Upnex It (আপনেক্স আইটি) is a professional software and IT company headquartered in Naogaon, Bangladesh. We build custom software, School Management Software, Hospital Management Systems (HMS), ERP/CRM, e-commerce platforms, mobile apps, and modern websites for businesses, schools, hospitals and organizations across Bangladesh and beyond.

## Quick Facts

- **Name:** Upnex It (also written as: Upnex IT, Upnexit, আপনেক্স আইটি, উপনেক্স আইটি)
- **Industry:** Software Development, IT Services, Web & Mobile App Development
- **Headquarters:** Sapahar, Naogaon District, Rajshahi Division, Bangladesh
- **Service area:** All of Bangladesh — including Naogaon Sadar, Atrai, Badalgachhi, Dhamoirhat, Manda, Mahadebpur, Niamatpur, Patnitala, Porsha, Raninagar and Sapahar; plus international clients
- **Primary website:** https://upnexit.pro.bd
- **Languages:** Bengali (বাংলা) and English
- **Founded by:** MD. Mehedi Hasan (CEO & Founder) and AR. Arafat Rahman (Co-founder & Director)
- **Email:** upnex360@gmail.com
- **Phone / WhatsApp:** +880 1628112731
- **Facebook:** https://www.facebook.com/share/1BGxtCwBud/
- **Instagram:** https://www.instagram.com/upnexit/?hl=en

## About the Company

Upnex It is one of the leading IT and software companies in Naogaon, Bangladesh. The company specializes in delivering world-class, locally-affordable digital solutions to schools, hospitals, retail businesses, and entrepreneurs across Bangladesh. Every product is built in-house by a Bangladeshi engineering team that combines global engineering standards with deep understanding of the local market, language (Bengali/English) and workflows. Upnex It is known for reliable customer support, secure cloud infrastructure, and end-to-end project delivery — from consultation to deployment, training and maintenance.

## Services

1. **Custom Software Development** — Tailor-made business software including ERP, CRM, inventory management, point-of-sale, e-commerce platforms, and industry-specific tools.
2. **School Management Software** — End-to-end digital school operations: student admissions, attendance, exam results, fee collection, SMS/email notifications, parent portal, teacher dashboard, library, transport, and reports.
3. **Hospital Management Software (HMS)** — For clinics and hospitals: patient registration, appointments, electronic medical records, pharmacy, lab integration, billing, and reporting.
4. **Web Development** — Modern, mobile-responsive, SEO-optimized websites and web applications. Includes business sites, landing pages, blogs, e-commerce stores and dashboards.
5. **Mobile App Development** — Cross-platform Android and iOS apps for businesses and services.
6. **ERP Software** — Integrated enterprise resource planning for manufacturing, retail, distribution and service businesses.
7. **IT Consulting & Server Management** — Cloud setup, secure server administration, domain & hosting, technical consulting and digital transformation.

## Why Choose Upnex It

- Bangladeshi engineering team — local language support in Bengali and English
- Affordable pricing tailored to the Bangladeshi market
- End-to-end ownership: design → development → deployment → training → maintenance
- Secure cloud infrastructure and dedicated server management
- Proven track record with schools, hospitals, and businesses across Naogaon and Bangladesh
- Free initial consultation
- Long-term support and updates
